description: RS256 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256) verification vectors. Test-only keys.

invalid_keys.name: rsa_1024
invalid_keys.why: RSA keys shorter than 2048 bits are skipped

invalid_keys.name: rsa_even_modulus
invalid_keys.why: an even modulus is not an RSA modulus

invalid_keys.name: rsa_exponent_one
invalid_keys.why: e = 1 makes every message its own signature

cases.name: rs-2048_truncated
cases.why: signature one byte shorter than the modulus

cases.name: rs-2048_extra_leading_zero
cases.why: signature one byte longer than the modulus

cases.name: rs-2048_s_equals_n
cases.why: signature representative equal to the modulus

cases.name: rs-2048_sha1_digest_info
cases.why: well-formed PKCS#1 v1.5 signature over SHA-1

cases.name: rs-2048_digest_info_without_null
cases.why: DigestInfo without the NULL parameters (only the canonical encoding is accepted)

cases.name: rs-2048_trailing_garbage
cases.why: shortened padding with data after the hash (BERserk-style)

cases.name: rs-2048_pss_signature
cases.why: a PS256 signature presented as RS256
